membership.ownApiKeyDesc: No model restrictions when using your own API keys. Configure multiple providers for maximum flexibility.
membership.faq1Question: Can I change my plan anytime?
membership.faq1Answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.
membership.faq2Question: What payment methods do you accept?
membership.faq2Answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and Alipay for international payments.
membership.faq3Answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for first-time subscribers.
membership.faq4Question: What happens when I exceed token limits?
membership.faq4Answer: Each membership tier has specific token usage limits for premium models. When you exceed your monthly token allocation, the system will automatically fallback to a lower-tier model (e.g., from GPT-5 to GPT-4o-mini) to ensure uninterrupted service. You can monitor your usage in the Usage Statistics page.
